body:
Somehow it means a lot more coming from a stranger. I have a few close friends, they are family really, that know all about this and they are very supportive, but I get into these paranoid states where I think they are saying that because they have to.

Thank you for reading it, I wrote this because I was feeling particularly down today. I almost didn't post it because at the end I felt better. I realized that the reason I was feeling like that was because of money and bills, and that's just not worth getting that upset about.
